text:
[LSER.18.1] Normative cross-reference. Each row is one aggregation;
columns are the four v1 time models. Every v1 cell is **exact** — there is
no accuracy phrase. Cells contain:

- **✓ exact** — exact answer at O(1) state or O(N) sample count.
- **✓** — exact, nothing further to note.
- **✗** — not available in v1: either the combination has no defined semantics,
  or it has no exact backing (see the footnotes).

| Aggregation | `all_time` | `sliding` | `tumbling` | `sample` | Backing | At capacity |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `mean` | ✓ exact | ✓ exact | ✗ § | ✓ exact | `SeriesBackendWelfordEwma` / `SeriesBackendRingBuffer` / `SeriesBackendReservoir` | drop |
| `sum` | ✓ exact | ✓ exact | ✗ § | ✓ exact | `SeriesBackendWelfordEwma` / `SeriesBackendRingBuffer` / `SeriesBackendReservoir` | drop |
| `count` | ✓ exact | ✓ exact | ✗ § | ✓ exact | `SeriesBackendWelfordEwma` / `SeriesBackendRingBuffer` / `SeriesBackendReservoir` | drop |
| `min` | ✓ exact | ✓ exact | ✗ § | ✓ exact | `SeriesBackendWelfordEwma` / `SeriesBackendMonotonicDeque` / `SeriesBackendReservoir` | drop |
| `max` | ✓ exact | ✓ exact | ✗ § | ✓ exact | `SeriesBackendWelfordEwma` / `SeriesBackendMonotonicDeque` / `SeriesBackendReservoir` | drop |
| `stdev`, `pstdev`, `variance`, `pvariance` | ✓ exact | ✓ exact | ✗ § | ✓ exact | `SeriesBackendWelfordEwma` / `SeriesBackendRingBuffer` / `SeriesBackendReservoir` | drop |
| `rate`, `direction` | ✓ | ✓ | ✗ § | ✗ | `SeriesBackendWelfordEwma` / `SeriesBackendRingBuffer` | drop |
| `first` | ✓ | ✓ exact | ✗ § | ✗ | `SeriesBackendWelfordEwma` / `SeriesBackendFifoDeque` | drop |
| `last` | ✓ | ✓ exact | ✗ § | ✗ | `SeriesBackendWelfordEwma` / `SeriesBackendFifoDeque` | drop |
| `bool_and`, `bool_or` | ✓ | ✓ exact | ✗ § | ✗ | `SeriesBackendWelfordEwma` / `SeriesBackendFifoDeque` | drop |
| `median`, `pXX` | ✗ † | ✓ exact | ✗ † | ✓ exact | `SeriesBackendRingBuffer` / `SeriesBackendReservoir` | drop |
| `count_distinct` | ✗ ‡ | ✓ exact | ✗ ‡ | ✗ | exact set (sliding) | drop |
| `count_of` | ✗ ‡ | ✓ exact | ✗ ‡ | ✗ | exact table (sliding) | drop |
| `contains` | ✗ ‡ | ✓ exact | ✗ ‡ | ✗ | exact set (sliding) | drop |

**At capacity** is what a declared `capacity` ([LSER.13.14]) does when an
identity's backing is full: **drop** evicts that identity's oldest sample, and
the read then covers the samples retained. A constant-state backing (`SeriesBackendWelfordEwma`)
retains no samples, so `capacity` never binds it. The time-normalised signal
aggregations refuse instead ([LSIG.1.1]).

† `median` / `pXX` need a **bounded** window for an exact quantile; their
`all_time` and `tumbling` forms are not available in v1.

‡ `count_distinct` / `count_of` / `contains` are exact on a **bounded**
(`sliding`) window only. Their `all_time` and `tumbling` forms have no exact
unbounded backend atom in v1, so, like the unbounded percentiles, they are
**not available in v1** ([LSER.18]).

§ **No `tumbling` form is backed in this edition** ([LSER.14.4.5]). The
per-bucket statistic over a completed bucket needs a backend that does not
ship; routing a `tumbling` line to the cumulative `SeriesBackendWelfordEwma` would return an
exponentially-weighted estimate (and `exp()` is not even cross-platform
bit-exact), and routing it to a windowed backing would read a sliding window,
not a bucket. The compiler refuses every `tumbling` line
(`DS_VALIDATE_SERIES_NO_EXACT_BACKING`, [LSER.15.2]).
